description: Sync server waypoints to Xaero's maps and VoxelMap, and teleport to waypoints on other servers behind Velocity. Commands and navigation work without the client mod.

mods.name: Server Waypoint
mods.description: A waypoint mod with automatic server-to-client syncing and cross-server teleportation, plus optional integration with Xaero's Minimap and VoxelMap.
